mostWorthwhile.text: Patching and repressurizing the habitat was the strongest passage: the backing plate, regulator and gauge made the emergency repair tangible.

leastWorthwhile.text: Cutting the shipping braces into stock was straightforward progress, but the list of future uses felt more like a preview than an immediate discovery.

surprise.text: The landing support could be stabilized with broad cribbing beside the folded strut rather than an immediate replacement.

arbitrary.text: Applying steel stock directly at the support skipped much of the construction process; the result explains the support but not quite how the pieces became cribbing.

continue.text: I would try another chapter: the concrete repair details and reuse of materials are promising, though the choices so far have been fairly obvious.
